title: GIT-IN-CLOUDFLARE-1: the Worker keeps its working copy in Cloudflare's Git-compatible storage and mirrors to GitHub; deploy targets sit behind one provider interface
body:
**Owner:** infrastructure-manager
**Trigger:** after ZERO-MINUTES-1 step 2 (Worker-native executor)
**Done check:** cmd:node deploy/probe-live.mjs --git
**Status:** open

Owner direction 2026-11-13: GitHub stays the master and public face; the loops need not depend on it; deploys may go to Cloudflare, AWS, GCP or GitHub. Unverified: what Cloudflare's Git-compatible storage supports (push, branches, size). Probe first: the Worker clones the repo into it, commits one change, pushes to the GitHub mirror; record result in ops/. Then add providers for deploy targets beside executor.js PROVIDERS. Practical Solutions bootstraps against the Worker loops, not Actions.
